note: The seven global paradigm factions as authored in issues #328 and #329. Every entry is a CONDENSATION OF AUTHOR TEXT, not an invention: the two issues state the same roster, and this file reconciles them into one — #329's naming is preferred where the two differ (Confederacy Awakening, Orion/Grey networks, Normalcy Bloc) and both are cited per field. Nothing here is a game rule, a statistic or a mechanic; per #329 section 5.7 no simulation rules are implemented before review. Where the author stated nothing, a field is null with a reason rather than being filled in.

provenance.note: Author intent is canon. A faction's stated PSI/NHI posture is that faction's in-world BELIEF, not a claim the game makes about reality; see evidence_model.

entity_kinds.label: Human ideological formation
entity_kinds.note: #329 section 4.2: a global ideology can influence a local political party without replacing it.

entity_kinds.label: NHI-aligned formation
entity_kinds.note: An external NHI power and/or its human supporters. Distinct kind of entity from a human movement.

entity_kinds.label: Latent public / sociological tendency
entity_kinds.note: #329 section 3.G: not a single organised party; a cross-faction tendency that can stabilise society and frustrate every ambitious faction.

economic.note: #327: left = redistribution, collective provision, state intervention; right = markets, property, deregulation. Descriptive simplification, not enough to explain everything.

social.note: #327: conservative/traditionalist vs liberal/pluralist. Do not conflate economic liberalism with social liberalism.

additional_dimensions.note: #329: recorded alongside the two conventional axes.

paradigm_positions.note: #329 section 4.1: encode each actor's stance to AGI, PSI, NHI and Confederacy accession SEPARATELY from the two conventional axes. They are not deterministically deducible from one another. This is the third dimension: two factions can land in the same compass cell and still differ entirely on the paradigm shift.

factions.label: Accelerationists
factions.subtitle: The Extraterrestrial Free Market

axis_defaults.social: internally socially libertarian, but often allied tactically with conservative right-populists
axis_defaults.note: #329: the satirical NooPunk antagonist archetype, NOT an allegation about all real libertarians, AI researchers or entrepreneurs. #328 records the author's own paradox: libertarians should be liberal but tend to be conservative far-right populists in practice.

stances.agi: Unfettered AGI/ASI, corporate ownership of infrastructure, machine-run corporations; indifferent to rogue-intelligence and biosphere risks.
stances.psi: Patent, commercialise, privatise and monetise psionic abilities; psychotronic products; consciousness-as-a-service.
stances.nhi: Immediate extraterrestrial trade liberalisation, alien investment rights, Extraterrestrial Economic Zones, private commercial treaties, NHI megacorporations, hybrid executives.

factions.positive_vision_note: Not stated by the author. The two issues frame this faction satirically as the antagonist archetype and give it resources and methods, not a positive programme; recording one would invent canon.
factions.extreme_end_state: The movement becomes the commercial collaborator, useful intermediary and eventual captive of malevolent Grey/Orion-linked forces, rogue AGIs, mind control and NHI hybrids. An end state is an assimilated galactic corporate order, not a triumphant independent humanity.
allies: tactically, conservative right-populists; commercially, Orion/Grey networks (see orion_grey_networks)
contradictions: Internal conflict between opportunists and true believers.
factions.cross_read: The willing commercial collaborator and recruitment target of the malevolent NHI coalition. Some leaders knowingly betray human autonomy; others believe they are simply doing business. #329 warns explicitly: not all Accelerationists are automatically infiltrated.
factions.author_verdict: #328, recorded as canon: this faction is the enemy of humanity, the biosphere and the entire universe.
references: Nick Land as a broad accelerationist inspiration
#329: the above is intentionally exaggerated science-fiction satire and should NOT be attributed as the literal positions of any named thinker
lore_anchors: rulebook_parts/07_lore_and_world.md section 33.2 (Accelerationist position; 'accelerationisms rather than one doctrine')

factions.label: Cyborgists
factions.subtitle: Conscious Agency and the Noosphere
factions.core: Human consciousness, agency, empathy and autonomy are more important than simply maximising machine intelligence. Humans evolve collectively rather than being replaced.
factions.canonical_formulation: AI is an assemblage of HUMAN, LLM, LANGUAGE and INTERNET: human consciousness and agency are the most important part, the LLM is an intelligence augmentation, and language and the internet are the collective intelligence of humanity.

stances.agi: Augmentation and cooperative/distributed intelligence, not corporate non-conscious AGI dominion; strong safeguards against rogue ASI.
stances.psi: An emergent or rediscovered natural human capacity in fiction; train carefully, ensure access, prevent coercion and psychic exploitation.
stances.nhi: Careful, compassionate diplomacy and exchange, plus Dark Forest awareness, defence, and respect for human sovereignty.

factions.positive_vision: Emancipatory posthuman flourishing, collective intelligence, conscious social-memory networks, pluralism, cooperative or commons-led evolution. Transform humanity without becoming someone's livestock, client species or compulsory hive mind.
factions.extreme_end_state_note: No bad end state is stated for this faction; the quoted failure mode above is what it seeks to avoid.
resources_methods: bridge science, civil society, consciousness research and sympathetic NHI
costs: difficult ethical tradeoffs, low initial funding, disputes over what counts as consent or consciousness
contradictions: Consciousness is treated as fundamental, which is a philosophical doctrine rather than an established in-universe fact (see #329 section 4.6).
factions.author_position: #328, recorded: I will join this faction when the Singularity starts.
references: Pierre Teilhard de Chardin, the noosphere
Aaron Bastani, Fully Automated Luxury Communism
#329: reference points, not assertions that the authors share every setting position

factions.label: Critical
factions.subtitle: Anti-Colonial Inquiry and Equality

stances.agi: Investigates technocapitalism, labour inequality, environmental costs, ownership and surveillance; can underrate benefits or dismiss some existential-risk warnings.
stances.psi: Initial skepticism and demands for evidence, then potentially an Archaic Revival that recognises long traditions of spiritual and psychic practice without treating any culture's claims as scientific proof. Opposes caste hierarchies between psi-capable and non-psi people; rejects appropriation, patriarchal domination and private monopolies.
stances.nhi: Opposes species-based prejudice, human supremacism and blanket assumptions about appearance or identity; scrutinises supposed benevolence, colonial extraction, surveillance, genetic manipulation and uneven technology transfer. Challenges Grey/Mantid/Reptilian caste systems, and is equally willing to criticise human exploitation.

factions.positive_vision: Excellent interspecies rights frameworks; #328's verdict: careful, balanced and sane left-liberal politics in the long run.
factions.extreme_end_state_note: None stated; the stated risk is a failure mode of its strength rather than an end state.
factions.risks: Productive skepticism can harden into denial.
contradictions: Skeptical enough to dismiss AI's actual benefits while being the faction most alert to technocapitalist harm.
Conflict over scientific verification, spiritual revival and NHI rights.
factions.guardrail: Critique of blonde/blue-eyed Pleiadian iconography must address its symbolism and racialised reception, never turn phenotype into proof of motive or moral character. #328 records the same worry from the author: handle it carefully, not racistly or speciesistly.
factions.author_verdict: #328: second favourite faction, after the Cyborgists.
references: #328 predicted arc: celebrates the Archaic Revival as liberation from western patriarchal capitalism

factions.label: Doomers / Butlerian Jihad
factions.subtitle: Humanity First at Any Cost

axis_defaults.economic: (not fixed by the author) biocentric and sovereignty-first rather than economically defined
axis_defaults.social: socially conservative and often right-populist, with potential heterodox environmentalist, secular-security, or left anti-tech offshoots
axis_defaults.note: #329: do NOT equate every AI-safety advocate or all believers with extremists.

stances.agi: Runaway AGI means extinction by default; demands bans, machine destruction, potentially rollback of augmentation and industry.
stances.psi: Fear infiltration, possession, witchcraft or uncontrollable psychic weapons; hardline factions prohibit practices.
stances.nhi: Dark Forest worst-case assumption: strike first or humanity is extinguished. A continuum from lawful precaution and diplomatic quarantine to militant conspiracism, armed survivalism, militia violence, civil war and genocidal anti-NHI campaigns.

factions.positive_vision_note: Not stated by the author; the two issues give this faction an escalation ladder and bad end states only.
factions.extreme_end_state: Militarised neo-medieval theocracy, anti-NHI genocide, collapse to survivalist enclaves, or self-destructive preventive war.
escalation_ladder: legal political advocacy against all forms of NHI
protests against the state if it does not adopt doomer policy
some doomers give up and go Mad Max
contradictions: Religious and ecological branches may disagree profoundly.
Their concern about X-risk may be empirically well-founded in particular incidents, giving them dramatically credible arguments.
factions.author_verdict: #328: second craziest faction; at least they do not want human extinction.
references: anti-industrial / extreme deep-ecology motifs as fictional inspirations, not blanket claims about actual activists
lore_anchors: rulebook_parts/07_lore_and_world.md section 33.3 (Butlerian Jihad and bioconservative reaction: 'It is not one monolithic organization' — bioconservatives, religious traditionalists, anti-AI movements, militant anti-transhuman organisations, separatist communities, terrorists, states)

factions.label: Confederacy Awakening / Galactic Ascension Movement

axis_defaults.note: Intentionally not reducible to the compass. Both the benevolent Confederacy and its political/religious human supporters are major global actors.

factions.core: Contact triggers a large fictional psychic awakening and an unprecedented conversion movement. It converts ordinary citizens and party members across all quadrants.

incompatible_readings.friendly: Joining a compassionate interstellar federation: ending warfare, ending animal suffering, ecological restoration, consciousness cultivation and collective intelligence; legitimate nonhuman diplomacy.
incompatible_readings.threatening: Childhood's End paternalism or alien religion masking coercion; human genetic engineering around 70,000 years ago (a setting claim requiring an in-universe evidence status); manipulated faiths; quarantine as a zoo; the Sphere Network as pervasive surveillance; and talk of humanity's Harvest.

conditions_associated_with_alliance: combat climate change and biodiversity collapse
altruistic communal/communist-like norms and a Noosphere / Social Memory Complex
factions.conditions_note: #329: distinguish proposals, negotiated rules, voluntary practices and coercive mandates; do not flatten them into unquestioned canon.
factions.core_tension: Universal peace versus loss of sovereignty, individual consent and private mental boundaries. An apparently beneficial contact can be genuinely alien and politically explosive without secretly being Orion.
contradictions: Polarising even though it is presented as the benevolent faction: its demands are simultaneously desirable and sovereignty-destroying, which is where its dramatic charge lives.
lore_anchors: section 33.6 psionics, QIP, awakening and the Noosphere
section 33.8 The Zoo: why quarantine exists
section 33.9 The Zookeepers and their probe ecology
section 33.11 Pleiadians, Atlantis and the second human Zoo
section 33.14 the end of quarantine, Day of Disclosure and Galactic Law
section 33.15 the VALIS event and birth of the conscious Noosphere

factions.label: Orion / Grey Collaborative and Infiltration Networks
factions.core: Malevolent NHI coalition (fictional setting) with covert hybridisation, abductive/biological caste and psychic manipulation capabilities, subject to verification by factions in play.
factions.relation_to_accelerationists: Accelerationist-aligned elites are attractive commercial partners and recruitment targets, but NOT all Accelerationists are automatically infiltrated. Use case-by-case evidence and separate actual hidden allegiance from accusatory propaganda and xenophobic witch hunts.
factions.play_note: Focus on network power, dependencies and information asymmetry. Reveal clues through player investigation rather than arbitrarily labelling all opponents aliens.
lore_anchors: section 33.6b rogue machine lineages and the Von Neumann threat
section 33.12 Greys, future humans and temporal ecology
section 33.13 hybridization and the Fourth-Density transition

factions.label: Normalcy Bloc
factions.subtitle: 1999 Forever
factions.core: A vast, politically diverse social segment refuses to update its everyday reality. Work continues, branding consultants relabel ontological crises, sports radio debates yesterday's scores, and government committees commission feasibility studies of whether the alien sphere is actually a sphere. The economy sells themed products while the social fabric melts.
factions.not_a_party: #329: do NOT make it a single organised party; treat it as a cross-faction sociological tendency / latent constituency.
factions.function: Inertia, distraction, normalcy bias, media attention and delayed institutional response. It can unexpectedly stabilise society and frustrate every ambitious faction.
factions.author_note: #328: a large segment of society is utterly unable to react to the paradigm shift; the author notes this appears to be happening in the real world too.

cross_cutting_rules.text: Retain the recognizable 2026 left/right economic and conservative/liberal cultural compass. Separately encode each actor's stance to AGI, PSI, NHI and Confederacy accession, plus sovereignty/agency/consent. These are not deterministically deducible from one another.

Human factions, alien factions, movements, institutions and latent publics are different kinds of entities. A global ideology can influence a local political party without replacing it. Faction membership and affinity can overlap, with competing internal wings.

Struggle over the signifiers Humanity, Survival, Progress, Freedom, Consciousness, Disclosure, Equality, Peace, Sovereignty and Harvest. Track articulations, antagonisms and contingent hegemonic alliances, not a forced single correct politics.

Corporate capital and platforms, research networks, religious networks, security networks and psychic/Sphere infrastructure provide different channels of network power. Exposure is not automatic consent or conversion.
Economic markets, law, science, religion, politics, medicine and security interpret the same events differently; crisis destabilises institutions and generates second-order conflicts.

Noosphere as voluntary solidarity versus imposed shared mind; PSI freedom versus psychological privacy; augmentation versus assimilation. 'Consciousness is fundamental' is a Cyborgist philosophical doctrine unless independently established in fiction.

Early ~2027 acceleration, competitive AGI policy and PSI controversies; controlled rogue AGI through bans and safeguards may shift agenda attention to PSI normalization and then NHI/sovereignty. These are branching game outcomes, not inevitable: rogue AI can recur, PSI may remain contested, NHI contact may fracture.
cross_cutting_rules.binding_note: #306: the crossover begins during the acceleration toward the NHI Crisis; the crisis must not be narrated as already resolved.

cross_cutting_rules.text: Have factions defect, ally, split and adapt based on shocks and incentives. Accelerationists need not always lose; Cyborgists and Critical need real fail states; Doomers may avert a genuine threat; the Confederacy may yield benefits and painful trade-offs.

evidence_model.rule: Never encode propaganda as automatically true. Distinguish what the game master knows from what factions assert. PSI, NHI, alien genetic engineering, Sphere surveillance, mind control and Harvest are in-universe hypotheses or events, not statements about proven real-world reality.

provenance_mapping.faction_assertions_propaganda_rumour: not EVIDENCE; recorded as the asserting faction's claim

mvp_scope.text: Keep the existing single-city/Ukweli opening, three local parties and modest faction-leader roster untouched. Introduce global ideological responses through small sets of tags, event cards, world news, NHI offers, economic pressure and NPC affiliations — not seven additional national parties or a giant globe simulator.
mvp_scope.mapping_note: Parties can borrow factions' discourse without being identical to global factions.

event_card_seeds: nothing to see here media cycle
event_card_note: #329 section 5.5 asks for 8-12 short playable event cards and names these eleven seeds. Recorded here as the authored seed list; the cards themselves are a design deliverable, not implemented.

deferred.simulation_rules: #329 section 5.7: propose the lightest simulation rules consistent with #297 and #309, with NO implementation before review. Not attempted here.
deferred.lore_doc_updates: #329 section 5.8: update relevant lore/design documentation only after agreement.
deferred.mechanics: strategy_game/RULEBOOK.md still says NO RULES APPROVED.

open_questions.text: Is the roster closed at seven, or is the Confederacy Awakening an umbrella covering both the genuine-awakening and the Childhood's-End-cult readings?
Are the Orion/Grey networks a playable faction, a non-player threat, or both?
Accelerationists and Orion/Grey overlap by design (collaboration). One faction with two wings, or two factions with a dependency?
Is the Normalcy Bloc a faction with agency, or purely a comedic and inertial pressure on other factions' legitimacy? #329 section 3.G leans to the latter.
How far along the Butlerian Jihad escalation ladder may the crossover begin, given #306 forbids narrating the NHI Crisis as already resolved?

Real-world reference policy: theorists named in these issues keep their names when attributing ideas (AGENTS.md section 6.1); political, corporate, media or celebrity figures acting inside fictional 20XX must be fictionalised.
Does the left/right placement override or refine the compass work in #327, or sit alongside it as the faction-level layer?

Which issue owns the canonical faction names — #328 or #329? They differ (Benevolent NHI faction vs Confederacy Awakening; Science Fiction Comedy vs Normalcy Bloc). This file prefers #329 and cites both, but the author should say which is authoritative.

boundaries: Author intent is canon; nothing here invents a mechanic, a number or a typology beyond what the author wrote.
Crossover only: this file lives in strategy_game/ and changes no legacy RULEBOOK.md canon (#306).
World lore carries over; legacy RPG rules do not.
Automated tests cover executable code only — never factions, lore or prose (#271).

registers.note: This document holds two registers. The seven entries in `factions` are the paradigm formations authored in issues #328 and #329. The four entries in `un_parliamentary_parties` are the UN parliamentary parties authored on 2026-10-14 (issue #470), recorded alongside them so that one file holds one schema for stances, signifiers, axes and kind. The register question — whether these four belong in the paradigm register at all, and how the 4 / 7 / 11 counts relate — is OPEN and is NOT decided here (docs/design/STRUCTURAL_FORKS_AND_DECISIONS.md fork 3; docs/design/AUTHOR_DECISION_QUEUE.md rows D9 and D17).
authoritative_for: paradigm stances (the five dimensions in stance_dimensions)
the qualitative six-quantity profiles of the four UN parties
not_authoritative_for: the UN roster itself — names, positions and legacy mapping live in data/world/un_parties.yaml
the Reality Tunnel and discourse prose — that lives in strategy_game/data/un_political_discourse.json and must stay consistent with this file

paradigm_shifts.note: The three paradigm shifts are distinct and are never collapsed into one pro/anti-alien axis (issue #470, canonical design clarification of 2026-10-14). Each party carries a separate position on each shift.

stance_dimensions.note: The five stance ids used by `factions` and `un_parliamentary_parties` alike, and by strategy_game/data/un_political_discourse.json. Three are the paradigm shifts; two are cross-cutting.

parties.label: Libertarian Accelerationist Party

axis_defaults.economic: right — market-libertarian, minarchist, open to extraterrestrial trade
axis_defaults.note: The author fixes the economic and market stance; no social-axis position is stated for this party, so none is recorded (AGENTS.md section 1).

parties.motto_note: No motto is authored for this party. The paradigm entry accelerationists carries one; assigning it here would invent canon.

stances.confederacy_contact: alien trade and open economic zones
stances.orion_conflict: security threat but also contested business relationships
stances.agi_asi: accelerate; repeal or exempt restrictive controls

opinion_support.note: weak and corroded: “not very popular despite massive corporate funding”, and the control or infiltration allegation attacks even that thin support.

membership_resources.note: its deepest quantity: megacorporate funding and funder networks, but no mass base.
